meaning: Ranks of the initially registered stone simulations, retired in observed callback order. Native IDs are allocated and retired by PhysX, never overwritten. Numeric IDs may differ because non-stone actors differ.
scope: Captured startup state of this fixed Unity scene; callback ordering for different game assets is not inferred.
nativeAdaptation: Register existing ice after all stones, then retire stones by observed relative registration rank. The surviving ice ID prevents IDPool highest-ID trimming. Smaller diagnostic rosters project the observed order.
